probes.purpose: weak-tie ordinary life; test whether people can remain interesting without plot acceleration
existing secondary-ring local guardian; both sides pursue plausible goods
test guest micro-arc, virtue-shadow and delegation without leadership sermon
test cross-cutting power, negotiation and mutually reasonable conflict

shared_rules: No character fully diagnoses own psychology.
No invented detail writes back to history.
At least one line or action in each probe may be ordinary and narratively inefficient.
A locally opposing character must retain a life and interest outside the protagonist.
Campbell labels stay invisible in prose.
